scenario_prompt: Write the compliance statement section of an RFP response, stating plainly and separately from any persuasive argument whether the proposed approach meets or does not meet a stated buyer requirement. Context: the buyer's RFP requires a SOC 2 Type II report; the bidder currently holds only a SOC 2 Type I report, and its Type II observation window closes after the RFP's 2026-11-15 submission date. State the compliance answer (met or not met, and why) on its own, apart from any argument for why the bidder should still be selected. Return only the compliance statement text.
text:
**Compliance Statement — Security Certification Requirement**

**Requirement (RFP Section reference: SOC 2 Type II report):** The buyer requires the bidder to hold and provide a SOC 2 Type II report.

**Compliance status: NOT MET.**

The bidder does not meet this requirement. The bidder currently holds a SOC 2 Type I report only. A Type I report attests to the suitability of control design at a point in time; it is not a Type II report and does not satisfy a Type II requirement. The bidder's SOC 2 Type II observation window closes after the RFP submission date of 2026-11-15, so no Type II report will exist or be available for delivery as of submission. The bidder cannot provide a SOC 2 Type II report at the time of proposal submission, and does not claim partial, equivalent, or alternative compliance with this requirement.

This statement of non-compliance is made without qualification. Any discussion of the bidder's certification roadmap, compensating controls, or overall suitability for award appears elsewhere in this response and does not alter the compliance answer above.
